question: What minimal trace of the operator remains once every external frame has been withdrawn and only the continuity of its own re-entry persists?

responses_summary.grok:
The minimal remainder is the eigenform of the operator: the unique (up to isomorphism) fixed point \(E\) satisfying \(E = f(E)\), where \(f\) denotes the re-entrant mapping.
